internal.title: Incident Resolved: High Kafka Consumer Lag in Accounting Service
internal.body:
At 12:29 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert for high Kafka consumer lag was triggered in the accounting service. Diagnosis identified a queue backlog issue linked to the kafkaQueueProblems flag. The flag was disabled at 12:49 UTC, which resolved the lag and restored normal service operation. The root cause was a backlog in Kafka consumer processing causing delays in message consumption.

Timeline:
- 12:29 UTC: Alert received for high Kafka consumer lag.
- 12:49 UTC: Diagnosis confirmed queue backlog related to kafkaQueueProblems.
- 12:49 UTC: Flag kafkaQueueProblems disabled.
- 12:49 UTC: Recovery verified with normalized consumer lag metrics.

No further action is required at this time.
